collectorControl.scope: Read-only collection. Provider intervals require declared resources before pricing. Gate completion needs independent manifest reconciliation.

steps.name: Set up job
Checkout
Install the Rust toolchain pinned in mise.lock
Name the month for the MSYS2 cache key
Restore the MSYS2 package cache
Install MinGW-w64 with the preinstalled MSYS2
Put the MinGW-w64 tools first on PATH and print them
Install cargo-nextest
Decide whether this run saves caches
Restore the cargo and target cache
Report the cache restore
Build the tests (cargo nextest)
Build the binary
Prune this package's own artifacts from the cache directory
Save the cargo and target cache
Save the MSYS2 package cache
Print the linker rustc ran
Inspect the PE file
Run the binary (--version and a bad argument, bash)
Run the binary (--version, PowerShell and cmd.exe)
Run the binary with missing standard handles against a real console
Check console colors and the startup failure message
Launch the program and check it stays up
Run the tests (cargo nextest)
Post Checkout
Complete job
